parsed.explanation: The dossier shows no trans-specific offence, no documented enforcement of the same-sex conduct statute (a dead letter per the 2015 report), no reported societal discrimination or violence, and a recognised traditional gender-diverse role (Pinapinaaine/Binabinaaine) — the 0.65-C/0.75-C pattern. Per rule 2, the unenforced sodomy statute is tangential and must not dominate. Deductions: thin and dated evidence (no post-2015 social-climate data, so absence of violence is weak — not proof of safety), no documented anti-discrimination machinery or complaint recourse, and unresolved visitor-facing questions (border document practice, custody placement, care access). These open questions and the thin formal-recourse record hold it a step below the acceptance-with-protections tier, around 0.65 rather than 0.75.
